notes: Descriptive EDA only; cycle bootstrap assumes independent cycles.
Intervals unadjusted for multiple comparisons; no prediction performance claim.
motor_iq is not equivalent to DC robot current; no summation/conversion.
All cycles used for statistics and alignment; no first-N selection.
Action alignment splits consecutive action+active runs and keeps visit number.
Bands represent 10-90% cycle spread, not confidence intervals.
Signed position/velocity differences assume matching target/feedback coordinates.
Feature summaries are sample-weighted; duration is preserved separately.
